question: For 2022 campaigns, which campaign had the highest campaign-window tagged net sales, which had the highest merchandise gross-profit proxy using catalog COGS, and are they the same?
answer:
These figures come from the synthetic Commerce Demo dataset, not a real retailer. [C1]

The campaign with the highest campaign‑window tagged net sales in 2022 was **PROMO‑0047 (Spring Sale 2022)** with net sales of **90345105.91**【C1】.  
The campaign with the highest merchandise gross‑profit proxy (i.e., the least negative value) was **PROMO‑0049 (Fall Launch 2022)** with a proxy of **‑1234030.8472199556053**【C1】.  
These two campaigns are not the same.

citations.sql_query: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name, p.promo_channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_sales, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - oi.quantity * pr.cogs) AS merchandise_gross_profit_proxy FROM commerce.promotions AS p INNER JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON (oi.promo_id = p.promo_id OR oi.promo_id_2 = p.promo_id) INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN commerce.products AS pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) = 2022 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_name, p.promo_channel LIMIT 100
